remarks: Tubular slide-stays with plant motif, originally in two parts but later fixed together; handle with knob of bone attached to moveable slide-stay. Ring in slide-bow, mounted on saddle. Inner slides shows little wear, and are perhaps replacements. Long secondary loop of tubing in bell sec., with tuning slide (capable of lowering pitch between half and whole tone), to which a long push-rod is attached; push-rod has knob of bone at proximal end. Small crease in bellpipe, patch in bell. One flat, decorated bell stay in primary bell section; tubular stay in secondary loop. Proximal border of garland has shell pattern with notches; garland is soldered to bell. Between signature and master’s mark, flanked with leaves, on one side a crown of tulips, on the other an engraved fruit resembling a pomegrantate. Nuremberg-style rim wire with braided pattern of leaves and flowers. Ferrules have grooves between rings. Has signature of Johann Wilhelm Haas, but master’s mark of Wolf Wilhelm. W.W. Haas was made master in 1721 and died in 1760 (Krickeberg & Rauch, citing Wörthmüller 1954: 325, 1955: 435). ****K & R cite Pechstein 1972, 201, as saying W.W. Haas was already master in 1706—dieses Datum ist wahrscheinlich—und hatte ein Meisterziechen mit den Initialen W W H. Einschublötstelle nach dem Bogen, der auf den Stimmzug folgt. Am Schallstück mit Zinn zugeschmolzene, kleine Risse, in der Sturze ein Flicken. Der Innenzug weist nur geringe Abnutzungsspuren auf; er ist vielleicht in jüngerer Zeit erneuert worden.
